name: rihal-prototype-harness
description: Rihal prototype-rail harness for the fullstack Next.js template: 34 lifecycle skills, 4 tiered agents (scout/senior-code-reviewer/security-architect/sre), 14 hooks (gate-quartet, push guard, skill-activation + path-lazy rule injection), and settings. Versioned per ADR-054 so forks can pin and detect staleness.
x-posture: publication-READY but intentionally UNPUBLISHED (ADR-062, #22 — supersedes the ADR-054 private-posture amendment). Versioning + /handoff portability today; publishing is a deliberate operator step per docs/plugin-publish-readiness.md (relocate to .claude-plugin/plugin.json, pick a channel, decide license/branding, release via changesets) + its own superseding ADR. Do NOT flip this to a public value or publish without that step.
x-versioning: Bumps ride the @changesets flow already in the stack: `npm run changeset` per harness-visible change, `npm run changeset:version` at release, then mirror the bump here. Changelog = the generated CHANGELOG.md from changesets plus docs/decisions/ADR-054-harness-plugin-and-agent-eval.md (amendments).
x-conformance: All skills validated against the agentskills.io open standard via `npm run skill-check` (scripts/skill-standard-check.mjs, V2-503): required name (≤64, lowercase-hyphen, matches dir) + description (≤1024), only spec-known optional fields. Keeps the .claude/ layer portable + publish-ready (the extractable gate pattern) without publishing — a marketplace step is a config flip per x-posture, not a rewrite.
